title: Announcement on a traditional checkpoint, Dak Ta Ok (Xekong Province, Laos) and Nam Giang (Quang Nam Province, Vietnam), to be upgraded into an international checkpoint, No 2204 / PMO on 17 December 2019.
text:
(Unofficial translation)

LAO PEOPLE’S DEMOCRATIC REPUBLIC

PEACE INDEPENDENCE DEMOCRACY UNITY PROSPERITY 

Prime Minister's Office     No. 2204/PMO

Vientiane Capital, 17 December 2019

Notification

Minister of Ministry of Foreign Affairs

Governor of Sekong Province

Subject: Application for upgrading the local checkpoint at Daktaork (Sekong province) - Nam Giang (Quangnam province) to become an international checkpoint

Pursuant to the letter of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs No.9380/MOFA, dated 27/11/2019.

According to the guidance of the Prime Minister on 16/12/2019.

The Prime Minister's Office is honored to announce on the "Agreement to upgrade the local checkpoint at Daktaork, Sekong Province to become an international checkpoint as proposed by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs". Sekong Province shall corporate with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to carry out in accordance with the prescribed regulations.

Please be informed for your reference and implementation.

Minister

Head of the Prime Minister's Office

Phet Phomphiphak
